label: protocol-change-1.1.2
note: protocol-change 1.1.1 -> 1.1.2 (Dylan's decision, 2026-10-07; commit ececc81). One rule added: RULER cells registered from 1.1.2 generate at most 32 tokens for niah_single_1 and niah_multikey_1 (protocol.json ruler_max_new); every other task keeps RULER's tokens_to_generate. Reason: raw-format Qwen runs never emit end-of-turn, so every arm generated 128 tokens for an 8-9 token answer (generation ~3/4 of a Qwen RULER cell's time). Basis: greedy decoding is causal; truncating FINAL-QWEN3-8B-RULER's 3,556 NIAH arm-rows to these budgets and rescoring with the official scorer changed 1 row and no arm's score (a flat 64-token cap changed 158 rows, not adopted). A config carries ruler_max_new only on the ruler set and only equal to protocol.json's; FINAL-QWEN3-8B-RULER ran at RULER's budgets and is not re-run. Configs stamped 1.1.x validate unchanged.
